A manometer is used to indicate the pressure in a steel vessel, as shown in the diagram.
liquid
manometer
steel vessel
What value does the liquid manometer give for the pressure in the vessel?
A
It is zero.
B
It is between zero and atmospheric pressure.
C
It is equal to atmospheric pressure.
D
It is greater than atmospheric pressure.

options.label: B
options.text: It is between zero and atmospheric pressure.

options.label: C
options.text: It is equal to atmospheric pressure.

options.label: D
options.text: It is greater than atmospheric pressure.
